qualification.details: post: Essential Qualification | assistant teacher, primary, urban: Graduate degree from a University established by law in India (or an equivalent Government-recognised degree), plus a Government-recognised training qualification - including Basic Teacher Certificate (B.T.C.), Biennial B.T.C. (Urdu), Special B.T.C., a Biennial Diploma in Special Education recognised by the Rehabilitation Council of India, or a 4-year B.El.Ed. degree, or a Biennial Diploma in Elementary Education per NCTE Regulations 2002 - AND must have qualified the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) conducted by the State Government or Government of India. (Note: the B.T.C. course is currently run under the name D.El.Ed.) | assistant teacher, sambaddh primary (aided schools): (1) Graduate degree from a University/deemed university/institution established by law or recognised by the Government in India, AND (2) B.T.C. or D.L.Ed. from an NCTE-recognised course, AND (3) must have successfully qualified the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) for Classes 1 to 5, conducted by the UP Government or Government of India.

selection_process: Selection for both posts is based on a Merit List prepared from a written examination of 360 marks
comprising 120 objective-type (MCQ) questions. Exam duration: 2 hours. Each question has 4 options

with only one correct answer to be marked on the OMR sheet using a black ball-point pen. Marking scheme: 3 marks awarded for each correct answer; 1 mark deducted for each wrong or multiple answer (negative marking). The question paper will be bilingual - in both Hindi and English. If the exam is held in multiple shifts

a score Normalization process will be applied (as per Commission notice No. Shiksha Seva Aayog/2018/2025-26 dated 26.02.2026) to enable fair comparison across shifts; only normalized scores will be used for selection. Tie-breaker rule: In case of equal merit
preference is given first to the candidate with a higher Graduation percentage
then to a higher Training Qualification percentage
and finally to the older candidate by age. Detailed exam syllabus is available for download on the official website
www.upessc.up.gov.in. No Travelling Allowance (TA) is payable for appearing in the written exam or for document verification.
how_to_apply: Complete One Time Registration (OTR) - mandatory before filling the application; OTR done on any other/older portal will not be valid.
Use the online payment gateway to pay the applicable examination fee via Credit/Debit Card or Net Banking.

Fill in the application form carefully and completely, in English only, indicating your preference between the two school-type options (Urban / Sambaddh Primary) - this preference cannot be changed after the deadline.
Upload a scanned signature on a white background (JPG/JPEG, 10 KB–200 KB, 140x110 pixel resolution) and a scanned passport-size photograph (JPG/JPEG, 30 KB–300 KB, 300–600 pixel resolution).
Upload all required certificates/documents in PDF format, each between 50 KB and 500 KB in size.
Review all entered details carefully - after final submission, changes to category, sub-category, date of birth, or gender will not be permitted.
Use the correction window (until 31.10.2026) only for correcting genuine errors; fees paid against an erroneous application are non-refundable and non-adjustable.
Submit the application and retain 3 printed copies for future reference - 2 of these copies, along with the required documents, must be submitted at the time of Document Verification.

content_sections.text: Fee can be paid via Credit Card, Debit Card, or Net Banking through the online payment gateway available on the portal, immediately after registration. Fee payment is confirmed only after bank confirmation is received; the fee receipt must be retained. content_sections.heading: UPESSC Assistant Teacher (Urban) Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern & Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for both posts is based on a Merit List prepared from a written examination of 360 marks , comprising 120 objective-type (MCQ) questions . Exam duration: 2 hours . Each question has 4 options, with only one correct answer to be marked on the OMR sheet using a black ball-point pen. Marking scheme: 3 marks awarded for each correct answer; 1 mark deducted for each wrong or multiple answer (negative marking). The question paper will be bilingual - in both Hindi and English. If the exam is held in multiple shifts, a score Normalization process will be applied (as per Commission notice No. Shiksha Seva Aayog/2018/2025-26 dated 26.02.2026) to enable fair comparison across shifts; only normalized scores will be used for selection. Tie-breaker rule: In case of equal merit, preference is given first to the candidate with a higher Graduation percentage, then to a higher Training Qualification percentage, and finally to the older candidate by age. Detailed exam syllabus is available for download on the official website, www.upessc.up.gov.in. No Travelling Allowance (TA) is payable for appearing in the written exam or for document verification.

content_sections.text: Visit the official website, www.upessc.up.gov.in. Complete One Time Registration (OTR) - mandatory before filling the application; OTR done on any other/older portal will not be valid. Use the online payment gateway to pay the applicable examination fee via Credit/Debit Card or Net Banking. Fill in the application form carefully and completely, in English only, indicating your preference between the two school-type options (Urban / Sambaddh Primary) - this preference cannot be changed after the deadline. Upload a scanned signature on a white background (JPG/JPEG, 10 KB–200 KB, 140x110 pixel resolution) and a scanned passport-size photograph (JPG/JPEG, 30 KB–300 KB, 300–600 pixel resolution). Upload all required certificates/documents in PDF format, each between 50 KB and 500 KB in size. Review all entered details carefully - after final submission, changes to category, sub-category, date of birth, or gender will not be permitted. Use the correction window (until 31.10.2026) only for correcting genuine errors; fees paid against an erroneous application are non-refundable and non-adjustable. Submit the application and retain 3 printed copies for future reference - 2 of these copies, along with the required documents, must be submitted at the time of Document Verification.

faq.question: Q1. What is UPESSC Assistant Teacher (Urban) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification (Advt. No. 05/2026) by the Uttar Pradesh Shiksha Seva Chayan Aayog for filling 12,405 Assistant Teacher posts - 11,508 in Urban Primary Schools under the Basic Education Department, and 897 in Sambaddh (Aided) Primary Schools under the Secondary Education Department.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in UPESSC Advt No. 05/2026?
faq.answer: There are 12,405 total vacancies: 11,508 for Assistant Teacher, Primary, Urban (across 75 UP districts), and 897 for Assistant Teacher, Sambaddh Primary (473 in boys' schools, 424 in girls' schools).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UPESSC Assistant Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Online registration begins 16.09.2026; the last date for online fee payment is 04.11.2026, and the correction window closes 31.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for UPESSC Assistant Teacher posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a graduate degree plus a recognised teaching qualification (B.T.C./D.El.Ed. or equivalent, as per NCTE norms), and must have qualified the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) for Classes 1 to 5.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UPESSC Assistant Teacher (Urban) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For the Urban post, the age limit is 21–40 years as on 01.07.2026, with 5 years' relaxation for UP's SC/ST/OBC candidates and 15 years for PwBD candidates. For the Sambaddh Primary post, the minimum age is 21 years, with a superannuation age of 62 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UPESSC Assistant Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹1,000 for General/OBC/EWS candidates, ₹500 for SC/ST candidates, and ₹300 for PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the exam pattern for UPESSC Assistant Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The written exam is of 360 marks with 120 objective-type MCQs, for a duration of 2 hours, with 3 marks for each correct answer and 1 mark deducted for each wrong/multiple answer.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for UPESSC Assistant Teacher posts?
faq.answer: Both posts carry a pay scale of Level-6, ₹35,400–₹1,12,400 per the 7th CPC pay matrix.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply online for UPESSC Assistant Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must complete One Time Registration (OTR) on www.upessc.up.gov.in, pay the fee online, fill the application form in English, upload the required photo/signature/documents, and submit before the deadline.

faq.question: Q10. When is the UPESSC Assistant Teacher (Urban) written exam scheduled?
faq.answer: The written examination is tentatively scheduled for 3 and 4 December 2026.
